ranked_evidence.snippet: # US measles cases reach 35-year high, for second record-breaking year in a row. Measles has continued its historic resurgence in the United States this year, with a second record-breaking year in a row. The disease was declared eliminated in the US in 2000, but more cases have been recorded in the past 18 months than there have been in the previous 25 years combined. Dozens of new cases are reported by the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention each week, with new large outbreaks adding to others that have simmered since last year. South Carolina has reported more measles cases in 2026 than any other state. ranked_evidence.snippet: [The Odyssey [2026]](https://in.ign.com/the-odyssey-2026 "The Odyssey [2026]"). # Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Becomes the Biggest Hollywood Box Office Opening of 2026 in India. ### A record-setting voyage at the Indian box office. Updated: July 22, 2026, 3:02 p.m. Related reads:The Odyssey Isn't 100% Matt Damon's Bulging Biceps — for One Scene His Stunt Double Was a Woman Who Had 'The Greatest Arms I've Ever Seen'. Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey has become the biggest opening for a Hollywood film in India in 2026. According to Sacnilk, the film has surpassed Evil Dead Burn, which previously held the record with ₹12.65 crore collected during its opening three days. The Odyssey earned India gross of ₹73.19 crore and an India net collection of ₹61.30 crore in its first weekend. Here's the day-wise box office breakdown:. The film has also delivered Christopher Nolan's biggest opening weekend in India. Its ₹73 crore opening weekend has comfortably surpassed the opening weekend collection of Oppenheimer, which earned ₹42.40 crore during its first three days in July 2023.
